svg.title: Owl & Night Blooms — fillable paint-by-number page
svg.desc: A recognizable horned owl with facial disks, forward-facing eyes, hooked beak, folded wings, talons, and night-blooming flowers. Full-color library preview; opening the SVG changes paintable regions into a numbered worksheet.
